name: Frostfire Bolt
entries: You hurl a bolt of frostfire that deals 2d8 cold and fire damage.

name: Earth to Sausages
entries: You draw together a handful of ordinary dirt and perform the gestures and words of this ritual. The dirt permanently transmutes into edible, if slightly suspicious-tasting sausages. The sausages still need to be cooked as normal sausages would. The sausages provide the equivalent of one rations worth of nutrition.
